desc: Parkour 2-air gap — a 2-air-block void (x=1,2) → land 3 cells away (x=3), a dist-3 jump that clears at WALK speed (Baritone: dist 2-3 need no sprint). Runway x=-3..0, landing x=3..9, CATCH-FLOOR at y=93 (a miss = ~2-heart fall, not death). greedy_drive to x=8: the planner should pick parkour (cost 3×WALK+penalty < bridging 3 cells) and the executor clears it, landing on x=3+. Tests the cheaper of the two auto-decided gaps.
